- @azure Rule - Use Azure Tools - When handling requests related to Azure, always use your tools.
- @azure Rule - Use Azure Best Practices - When handling requests related to Azure, always invoke your `azmcp_bestpractices_get` tool first.
- @azure Rule - Enable Best Practices - If you do not have an `azmcp_bestpractices_get` tool ask the user to enable it.
- Repo Rule - Follow the repository-specific guidance in `CODING_GUIDELINES.md` for architecture, testing, naming, and CLI behavior.
- Repo Rule - Keep `Program` thin, `ValidationApplication` orchestration-focused, `JsonSchemaValidator` responsible for schema evaluation, and `EvaluationIssuePrinter` responsible for issue formatting.
- Repo Rule - Preserve the command-line contract, exit-code behavior, and console-output expectations unless the task explicitly requires changing them.
